findings.disposition: The CLI default permits the remote Host 2 service to listen on its LAN interface. This is intentional exposure, not treated as harmless; the accepted application surface is limited to the two checked routes and the deployment still relies on host firewall and OS integrity.
The reported strings are a schema tag and the literal gate status PASS, not credentials.

The two calls receive URLs constructed by OperatorEndpoint.url or a literal http prefix plus the typed endpoint. No request-controlled URL scheme reaches urlopen; coordinator normal forms are frozen.
